name: daoco
description: Marketing for personal and business brands. Set up your brand, use its context, create and publish content, run campaigns and recurring work, fix your website, and follow work in Daoco.

interface.longDescription:
Daoco is a marketing team for your personal or business brand. It keeps what your brand knows about itself, including voice, audience, positioning, visual identity, products, and past performance, and uses it to do marketing work: research audiences and competitors, plan campaigns, write social posts, emails, and website pages, make images and video, and review performance.

With this plugin you can set up a brand and read its saved context; start work in your own words and follow it as it runs; ask for changes; and get back the finished posts, reports, charts, images, and videos. You can also post what you wrote to your connected social accounts now or on a schedule, use your other connected apps such as a CRM or store, set up routines that run while the app is closed, work through the fixes Daoco found on your website, and see what Daoco suggests making next. Work runs in Daoco, takes minutes, and uses your workspace's tokens.

For people building a personal brand (creators, founders, consultants, experts) and for businesses and marketing teams.

Limitations: the plugin never approves anything. Your brand's approval settings in Daoco decide whether publishing and changes in connected apps wait for a person, who approves in Daoco or from their personal assistant through the links the plugin returns. Connecting accounts and billing happen in Daoco at daoco.org.
